payload.title: File:Gigantoraptor size.png
payload.description_html: Size chart for Gigantoraptor erlianensis. The size of the eggs are based on fossil eggs previously assigned to Tarbosaurus bataar[1]. Some scientists, however, have assigned these eggs to a large oviraptorosaur.
